appointment_completion_rate.name: Appointment Completion Rate
appointment_completion_rate.description: Percentage of scheduled appointments successfully completed.

no_show_rate.name: Patient No-Show Rate
no_show_rate.description: Percentage of patients missing scheduled appointments without prior cancellation.

cancellation_rate.name: Appointment Cancellation Rate
cancellation_rate.description: Proportion of appointments cancelled prior to consultation.

avg_consultation_duration.name: Average Consultation Duration
avg_consultation_duration.description: Average duration physicians spend per patient consultation.

capacity_utilization.name: Doctor Capacity Utilization
capacity_utilization.description: Proportion of total available clinic consultation hours utilized.

average_revenue_per_visit.name: Average Revenue per Visit (ARPV)
average_revenue_per_visit.description: Mean revenue generated across completed patient visits.

billing_collection_efficiency.name: Billing Collection Efficiency
billing_collection_efficiency.description: Percentage of total invoiced clinic revenue successfully collected.

data_anomaly_rate.name: Operational Data Anomaly Rate
data_anomaly_rate.description: Percentage of operational records exhibiting schema or integrity errors prior to cleaning.
